messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> #eng-sre oncall @aj: P1 serving: high error rate + container crashloops in eu-west. Please triage.
aj: acked — landing on this now. grabbing logs and scaling metrics.
maria: seeing huge churn on the scaler for inference-pool-eu: scale events 8 -> 24 -> 6 within ~3m, repeated. that will saturate new nodes and warmups.
aj: logs from pod redwood-infer-7b-xxx (last restart):
```
[2026-03-15T06:34:12Z] runtime: allocating attention KV cache
E CudaOutOfMemory: failed to allocate 1.2GiB on device 0
stack: ...
Container exited with code 137
```
leo: node flaps observed at same time, node-eu-az1-3 went NotReady and restarted kworker. suspect autoscaler reacting then removing capacity while pods still initializing -> crashloops.
tanvi: confirmed, node events:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep eu-az1
node-eu-az1-3   NotReady   4d   10.2.3.45
node-eu-az1-5   Ready      12d  10.2.3.47
```
ben-cs: customers reporting 502/503s in EU traffic; support tickets spiking ~120/min. we need ETA and mitigation.
aj: impact summary so far — 502 rate ~18% for inference routes in eu-west, median latency x3 for in-flight requests. affected models: redwood/gpt-infer-7b-quant (heavy alloc) and some 13b variants.
maria: quick root hypothesis: autoscaler aggressiveness + short cooldowns -> rapid scale-up then scale-down while pods still pulling CUDA memory -> OOMs + restart storms. the runtime's memory commit during warmup is high (KV cache + JIT).
leo: short-term mitigation: 1) raise min replicas to 12 in eu to stop scale-to-zero oscillation 2) increase HPA cooldown to 5m 3) restrict scheduling of heavy models to nodes with 64GB GPUs (taint + toleration)
aj: executing mitigations now. running commands:
```bash
# set min replica to 12
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-pool-eu -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":12}}'
# bump cooldown in autoscaler configmap
kubectl -n infra edit configmap autoscaler-config
# cordon node-eu-az1-3
kubectl cordon node-eu-az1-3
```
aj: applied minReplicas=12 and cordoned suspect node. scaling activity slowed. confirming pods are stabilizing.
sre-bot: ACTION: autoscaler policy change submitted by aj. change id ac-20260315-17. 2 reviewers required for permanent change.
ben-cs: do we have a customer-facing blurb? need to update status page. severity high.
maria: quick blurb for status page: "We are investigating elevated error rates for inference requests in eu-west. Clients may experience increased latency and intermittent errors. Engineers are mitigating scaling instabilities." please sign-off @ben-cs
ben-cs: sending now.
tanvi: i can take owner for postmortem and follow-up; i'll collect logs, scaler graphs, and allocation traces. tagging @maria and @leo to hand over. expecting to dig in after 07:00 UTC.
aj: handoff: system stable for now — error rate dropped to ~1.5% after minReplica bump and cordon. leaving a watch for 30m, then will revert any temporary changes if safe.
maria: adding one more note: long-term fix options: add damping to autoscaler to prefer sustained CPU/RAM signals, tune model warmup to pre-allocate KV cache lazily, and add anti-flapping in scheduler.
leo: creating a follow-up ticket: INF-3842 "autoscaler damping + model warmup improvements" and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-sre.
ben-cs: status page updated, customers notified. thanks all.
aj: final: leaving the channel for handoff. @tanvi you own the postmortem. please include customer impact timeline and rollback plan. i'll attach command logs and HPA events to the ticket.
tonvi: ack (typo fixed) — tanvi here, taking it.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (temporary minReplicas, node cordon, increased cooldown). monitoring shows error rate back to baseline. incident severity downgraded.
aj: closing the pager, will stay reachable if it flares.
tanvi: collecting artifacts now, will post a 1-pager and RCA draft in #postmortems by EOD.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: auto-closure in 2h unless reopened. :white_check_mark:
